title: Everyday Phrases — Making Pizza at Home
scene_zh: 自製披薩 · 情境對話
title_quote: Let's make pizza at home tonight.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍕 實用自製披薩必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Making Pizza at Home
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用自製披薩情境對話（從和麵發酵、鋪料進爐到切片回熱，每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Making Pizza at Home phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering dough, toppings, baking and cleanup. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's make pizza at home tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們在家自己做披薩吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I love homemade pizza.
dialogue.zh: 好主意,我最愛吃自製披薩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours will be faster and cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a full bag right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the little packet in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈpækɪt ɪn ðə drɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the date on this yeast?
dialogue.zh: 這酵母的期限是什麼時候?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's good until late this fall.
dialogue.zh: 秋天結束前都不會過期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can safely use it.
dialogue.zh: 太好了,我們可以安心用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the big mixing bowl too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it on the counter, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much flour do we need?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it in nice and slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cup, two cups, three cups, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kʌp, tu kʌps, θri kʌps, dʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now add a pinch of salt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll stir it in with a spoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stɜr ɪt ɪn wɪð ə spun./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot water kills the yeast, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cup of warm water here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour it into the small cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now where does the yeast go?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the yeast and sugar to the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə jist ænd ˈʃʊɡər tu ðə kʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it, then wait five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look for tiny bubbles in the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk fər ˈtaɪni ˈbʌbəlz ɪn ðə kʌp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pour the foamy yeast in, add olive oil.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr ðə ˈfoʊmi jist ɪn, æd ˈɑlɪv ɔɪl./
dialogue.zh: 把起泡的酵母倒進盆裡,再淋一點橄欖油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push it away, then fold back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's right, knead for ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, roll it into a soft ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst, roʊl ɪt ˈɪntu ə sɔft bɔl./
dialogue.zh: 先把麵團揉成一個軟球。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead, cover it with a towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd, ˈkʌvər ɪt wɪð ə ˈtaʊəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let it rise one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it nearly doubles in size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While it rests, preheat the oven.
dialogue.zh: 等它發酵時,先預熱烤箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it to four twenty five degrees.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt tu fɔr ˈtwɛnti faɪv dɪˈɡriz./
dialogue.zh: 設定到華氏四百二十五度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot ovens make the best pizza.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I put the tray in?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, warm the empty tray first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這樣底部才會變酥脆嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, a hot tray helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ə hɑt treɪ hɛlps ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 沒錯,預熱的烤盤很有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the dough is rising fast!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 跟沒發酵前比,大了一倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you like plain cheese pizza?
dialogue.zh: 你喜歡原味起司披薩嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with lots of cheese, please!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I shred it or slice it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ʃrɛd ɪt ɔr slaɪs ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 刨碎的起司融化得更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have peppers and olives?
dialogue.zh: 那我們有青椒跟橄欖嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peppers are here, olives too, we're set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛpərz ɑr hɪr, ˈɑlɪvz tu, wɪr sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 青椒在這,橄欖也有,齊全了!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's clean, just dry it off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the hook beside the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the dough in the middle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press it down with your hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You got it, roll, turn, roll again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɑt ɪt, roʊl, tɜrn, roʊl əˈɡɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it stick to the board?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go on, poke the whole base.
dialogue.zh: 好,把整個餅底都戳一戳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it bakes flat, not puffy.
dialogue.zh: 這樣烤出來才平整不鼓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just light dots, no deep cuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move it onto the baking tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, it sits nice and flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stir it with a big spoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I need to add salt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like a real pizzeria.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spoon the sauce in the center.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Less sauce means a crispier crust.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spread it in a slow circle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave a border for the crust.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back of the spoon works.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, more cheese never hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the crust can turn brown.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half the cheese goes on now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We add more over the toppings.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The base is ready to build on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə beɪs ɪz ˈrɛdi tu bɪld ɑn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks like an empty canvas.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the jar by the sink?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 是乾奧勒岡,一小撮就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll rub it in my hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cook it first, it's too wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the center a bit lighter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 青椒能添上漂亮的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a few, not too many.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a few rings on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, olives are salty and wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tuck a few leaves here and there.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʌk ə fju livz hɪr ænd ðɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A heavy pizza won't cook well?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the rest of the cheese.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它差一點就放不下烤盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 餅邊乾淨,起司均勻,好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The oven is fully hot now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want me to slide it in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘?食譜上寫十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My oven runs a bit cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, timer on, twelve it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A quick peek, don't lose heat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cheese is starting to melt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the crust is turning color.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Golden brown all around the rim.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the mitts, take it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the tray onto the rack.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the tray too hot to touch?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə treɪ tu hɑt tu tʌtʃ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the crust keep its shape?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big bubbles rose on the rim.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we bake a second one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen is a little messy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, with a mat below it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got the mat right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more minutes, then we cut.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could I have the chili flakes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now for the big cheese pull.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift it slow, watch it stretch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I snap one quick picture?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 鹹鹹的橄欖,帶煙燻味的香腸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More basil for aroma next time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, we need a basil plant.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, five minutes, then cover it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It keeps two or three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then how do I warm it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the table is a mess.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it won't scratch the wood.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweep the flour off the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the tray to the sink.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's still too hot to wash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let it cool, then soak it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 櫃子裡比較乾燥,適合放酵母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll pick the toppings next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, aɪl pɪk ðə ˈtɑpɪŋz nɛkst taɪm./
